events.reasoning: Evidence says hrMemorySize (1.3.6.1.2.1.25.2.2) does not move under load, so it is a total/constant: 'The amount of physical read-write main memory... contained by the host.' Rejected totals/constants: hrMemorySize and hrStorageSize ('The size of the storage... in units of hrStorageAllocationUnits'). Rejected per-process hrSWRunPerfMem ('The total amount of real system memory allocated to this process') - not device-wide. No MikroTik mtxr memory-used object exists in list. Therefore choose device-wide hrStorageUsed filtered to RAM, which rises when 1 GiB is allocated. Scale 1024 assumes hrStorageAllocationUnits=1024 for RAM as typical; poller should multiply by actual hrStorageAllocationUnits instance for the row.

pick.evidence: The amount of the storage represented by this entry that is allocated, in units of hrStorageAllocationUnits.

witness.why_independent: Total RAM size is constant when 1 GiB is allocated; independent of Used and allows utilisation percent = Used/Size
